perfume.answer: Etihad allows perfumes and sprays in checked baggage and, in cabin baggage, only in containers of up to 100 ml; flammable liquids and spray paint are not permitted.

sections.h: 🧴 What Etihad Airways says about perfume and aerosols
sections.p: From the Etihad page "Prohibited items and what you can take on board", liquids, aerosols and gels table, read on 22 November 2026.

head: Question
Etihad Airways rule
rows: Creams, lotions, cosmetics, oils, perfumes, sprays, gels
Allowed in checked baggage; in cabin baggage only up to 100 ml per container, under the conditions
Cabin baggage only up to 100 ml per container
Flammable liquids such as lighter fluid, petrol, alcohol or ethanol, paint thinner, spray paint
Not permitted in cabin or checked baggage

list: Not on the page: the part of the page read gives no total weight or litre limit for checked perfume.

faq: Can I take perfume in my Etihad hand baggage?
Only in containers of up to 100 ml. Larger bottles go in checked baggage.
Is spray paint allowed on Etihad?
No. Aerosol spray paint and other flammable liquids are not permitted in cabin or checked baggage.
